--- slide 2: October net sales total is 50.0% above September, but October is missing 17 days and only 19 of 31 days of October are counted and September is missing 28 days: per reported day it is up 50.0%
Metric | October 2026 | September 2026 | Change | Change % | Note
Orders | 20 | 15 | +5 | +33.3% | October partial: 17 days missing; October partial: 19 of 31 days; September partial: 28 days missing; per reported day up 33.3%
Gross sales | $240.00 | $150.00 | +$90.00 | +60.0% | October partial: 17 days missing; October partial: 19 of 31 days; September partial: 28 days missing; per reported day up 60.0%
Refunds | $30.00 | $10.00 | +$20.00 | +200.0% | October partial: 17 days missing; October partial: 19 of 31 days; September partial: 28 days missing; per reported day up 200.0%
Net sales | $210.00 | $140.00 | +$70.00 | +50.0% | October partial: 17 days missing; October partial: 19 of 31 days; September partial: 28 days missing; per reported day up 50.0%
Average order value | $12.00 | $10.00 | +$2.00 | +20.0% | October partial: 17 days missing; October partial: 19 of 31 days; September partial: 28 days missing
Buyers per active day | 8.0 | 6.5 | +1.5 | +23.1% | October partial: 17 days missing; October partial: 19 of 31 days; September partial: 28 days missing
Ad spend | EUR 180.00 | EUR 150.00 | +EUR 30.00 | +20.0% | October: 17 days missing; October: 19 of 31 days; September: 28 days missing; per reported day up 20.0%
Return on ad spend | 4.50 | 3.33 | +1.17 | +35.0% | October: 17 days missing; October: 19 of 31 days; September: 28 days missing; on 1 of 2 days
Search clicks | 20 | 30 | -10 | -33.3% | October: 17 days missing; October: 19 of 31 days; September: 28 days missing; per reported day down 33.3%
Average position | 6.0 | 6.5 | -0.5 | -7.7% | October: 17 days missing; October: 19 of 31 days; September: 28 days missing
Source: the store's daily order records.
Ad rows: Meta, in the ad account's currency (EUR), purchases in a 7 day click window. Search rows: Search Console, Pacific time, a lower position is nearer the top.
Change % is the change over September's figure, n/a when that was zero. Buyers per active day is the average of each day's distinct buyers, over days with orders. Average order value is gross sales divided by orders.
Per reported day divides a total by the days with orders plus the days with no orders, so months with different numbers of days with data can be compared.

--- slide 9: October refunds total is 200.0% above September, but October is missing 17 days and only 19 of 31 days of October are counted and September is missing 28 days: per reported day it is up 200.0%
Net sales total was $210.00 in October, 50.0% above September ($140.00), but October is missing 17 days and only 19 of 31 days of October are counted and September is missing 28 days: per reported day, net sales are up 50.0% ($105.00 against $70.00).
Orders total was 20 in October, 33.3% above September (15), but October is missing 17 days and only 19 of 31 days of October are counted and September is missing 28 days: per reported day, orders are up 33.3% (10.00 against 7.50).
The biggest move was Refunds, 200.0% above September in total, but October is missing 17 days and only 19 of 31 days of October are counted and September is missing 28 days: per reported day it is up 200.0%.
The best day was Oct 1 with net sales of $150.00.
17 days have no data (Oct 3, Oct 4, Oct 5, Oct 6, Oct 7, Oct 8, Oct 9, Oct 10, Oct 11, Oct 12 and others), so the totals are understated.
Only 19 of 31 days of October are counted, so the totals are partial.
Sessions total was 410 in October, 36.7% above September (300), but October is missing 2 days of website data and only 19 of 31 days of October are counted: per reported day, sessions are up 141.2% (24.12 against 10.00).
Order rate was 4.9% in October, down 2.4% from September (5.0%), and October is missing 2 days of website data and only 19 of 31 days of October are counted.
2 days have no website data (Oct 5, Oct 6), so the website totals are understated.
Ad spend total was EUR 180.00 in October, 20.0% above September (EUR 150.00), but October is missing 17 days of ad data and only 19 of 31 days of October are counted and September is missing 28 days of ad data: per reported day, ad spend is up 20.0% (EUR 90.00 against EUR 75.00).
Return on ad spend was 4.50 in October, up 35.0% from September (3.33), and October is missing 17 days of ad data and only 19 of 31 days of October are counted and September is missing 28 days of ad data.
17 days have no ad data (Oct 3, Oct 4, Oct 5, Oct 6, Oct 7, Oct 8, Oct 9, Oct 10, Oct 11, Oct 12 and others), so the ad totals are understated.
Search clicks total was 20 in October, 33.3% below September (30), but October is missing 17 days of search data and only 19 of 31 days of October are counted and September is missing 28 days of search data: per reported day, search clicks are down 33.3% (10.00 against 15.00).
Average position was 6.0 in October, down 7.7% from September (6.5), and October is missing 17 days of search data and only 19 of 31 days of October are counted and September is missing 28 days of search data.
17 days have no search data (Oct 3, Oct 4, Oct 5, Oct 6, Oct 7, Oct 8, Oct 9, Oct 10, Oct 11, Oct 12 and others), so the search totals are understated.
Narrative written from the computed figures on the previous slides.
--- slide 10: Data health: October is missing days of store, website, ads and search data
Source, October | Days with data | Days with nothing to report | Days with no data | Days that may still change | Stored daily figures used
Store | 2 | 0 | 17 | n/a | 12
Website | 2 | 15 | 2 | n/a | 8
Ads | 2 | 0 | 17 | 0 | 8
Search | 2 | 0 | 17 | 0 | 6
Days with no data in October, store: Oct 3, Oct 4, Oct 5, Oct 6, Oct 7, Oct 8, Oct 9, Oct 10, Oct 11, Oct 12 and 7 more.
Days with no data in September, store: Sep 3, Sep 4, Sep 5, Sep 6, Sep 7, Sep 8, Sep 9, Sep 10, Sep 11, Sep 12 and 18 more.
Days with no data in October, website: Oct 5, Oct 6.
Days with no data in October, ads: Oct 3, Oct 4, Oct 5, Oct 6, Oct 7, Oct 8, Oct 9, Oct 10, Oct 11, Oct 12 and 7 more.
Days with no data in September, ads: Sep 3, Sep 4, Sep 5, Sep 6, Sep 7, Sep 8, Sep 9, Sep 10, Sep 11, Sep 12 and 18 more.
Days with no data in October, search: Oct 3, Oct 4, Oct 5, Oct 6, Oct 7, Oct 8, Oct 9, Oct 10, Oct 11, Oct 12 and 7 more.
Days with no data in September, search: Sep 3, Sep 4, Sep 5, Sep 6, Sep 7, Sep 8, Sep 9, Sep 10, Sep 11, Sep 12 and 18 more.
October is not over: 19 of 31 days are counted.
A month with days missing is understated, so its changes are marked partial.
For each source, days with data, days with nothing to report and days with no data add up to the days in the month.
A day with nothing to report is one where a data pull ran and found none. A day with no data is one no data pull covered. A day that may still change is one close to the report date: purchases and search figures are restated for a few days.
--- provenance (file property, not on a slide): Written by a fixed template from the computed figures (no model key is set). No model was used.
